description: Korean industrial accident leave pay (산재 휴업급여) for 2026: 70% of average daily wage, the low-income minimum-wage guarantee (82,560 KRW a day), the maximum compensation base 268,299 KRW, nothing when treatment is 3 days or less. Give avgDailyWage, or threeMonthWages with calendarDays.

annualBonus.description: Bonuses paid in the last year (3/12 added) (KRW)

threeMonthWages.description: Wages in the 3 months before the accident (instead of avgDailyWage) (KRW)

name: calculate_kr_injury_leave_pay
title: Calculate Korea injury leave pay
